result:
Can't run tests here (no pytest installed).

Root cause: `strip_reminders` in `anthrouter/request_text.py` says it trims outer whitespace, but it didn't. After the `<system-reminder>` block was removed, a leading `\n` stayed, so `startswith(ACTIVITY_LABEL_PREFIX)` failed.

Fix: `strip_reminders` now ends with `.strip()`. This fixes every caller (`handlers.py`, `model_router.py`), not just `is_activity_label_prompt`.

I didn't run the test suite. Callers that previously saw untrimmed text will now see trimmed text.
